capabilities: run timed focus sessions with a status-bar timer and optional reflections
track goals with deadlines, priorities, milestones and logged progress
log session time and reflections into linked labbook notes
generate daily notes with hourly plans and weekly plans per ISO week
generate a weekly project report comparing hours and goal progress
disambiguation: More than a focus timer: it also manages deadline-based goals, labbook notes, and weekly reports.
extras: Part of the author's OrbitKit collection of Obsidian plugins; the repository is generated from there. README acknowledges AI assistance (Claude) for code, tests and documentation. Data stays local in data.json, with the time log keeping about 400 days of entries.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in time tracking, focus sessions, or deadline-based goal planning, and stock daily notes have no structure for logs and hourly plans.
summary: Focus-session timer and goal tracker that logs deep-work time, deadline-based goals with labbooks, daily/weekly plan notes, and a weekly project report.
